landing.powered_by: Powered by Multimodal LLMs & Speech Models
landing.hero_desc: Save hours of study and research. The multimodal AI system automatically synchronizes visuals, audio, and slide text to extract high-quality summaries from academic lectures.
landing.core_engine_desc: The system combines 3 main data streams to comprehensively analyze video content, ensuring no critical information is missed.
landing.audio_desc: High-accuracy ASR with WhisperX and speaker diarization.
landing.visual_desc: Slide transition detection (PySceneDetect) and on-screen text scanning (PaddleOCR).
landing.sync_desc: Align audio-visual data and create vector knowledge base in ChromaDB for summarization and Q&A.
landing.features_desc: Designed to best meet the requirements of studying, analyzing, and extracting lecture knowledge.
landing.abstractive_desc: Not just raw extraction, the AI generates high-quality summaries, explains terminology, and organizes coherent learning objectives.
landing.abstractive_support: Supporting major research institutes and universities
landing.chaptering_desc: Automatically split video into content chapters corresponding to main slides and discussion topics.
landing.qa_rag_desc: Direct Q&A chat. Cite answers based on video context and slides with linked timestamps.
landing.metrics_desc: Monitor GPU cluster status, audio/visual processing speed, and OCR accuracy visually.
landing.cta_desc: Experience the system today to enhance your reading comprehension of online lectures and scientific conferences.

docs.title: User Guide
docs.overview_desc3: - The next-generation intelligent lecture analysis platform, maximizing learning and video research support.
docs.feat1_desc: Just paste a Youtube link or upload a video file, the system automatically extracts audio and detects lesson slides.
docs.feat2_desc: No need to watch hours of long videos, you can grasp the core content after reading the summary for 2-3 minutes.
docs.step1_desc: The system receives the video, checks format and length limits in DB to queue it.
docs.step2_desc: The WhisperX model translates speech to text with timestamps, while CLIP scans for slide transition moments.
docs.step3_desc: LLM (GPT-4o/Gemini) writes reports, outputs chapters, and puts all data into ChromaDB vector database.
docs.summary_desc: The language module processes the entire text transcript from the instructor's voice to build the most complete comprehensive document.
docs.whisper_desc: WhisperX provides spell correction using a context dictionary and precise word-level timestamping, letting you click any sentence in the transcript to jump to that exact second in the video.
docs.chapter_desc: Using context analysis algorithms, the LLM detects main topics and divides the lesson video into clear chapters. Each chapter comes with a start/end time and a brief description.
docs.usage_title: How to use the Summary Interface:
docs.usage_step1: Go to the History page to view your video list.
docs.usage_step2: Select the desired video to open the analysis results page.
docs.usage_step3: On the left is the Summary tab showing the main points, and the Transcript tab helps you read the entire instructor's speech.
docs.keyframe_desc: To support visual learning, the system integrates image analysis algorithms so you don't miss content shown on the board/screen.
docs.kf_step1_desc: Use edge detection to find moments when presentation slides change or the instructor writes on a new board, minimizing image duplication.
docs.kf_step2_desc: The CLIP model maps lecture images and translated text to link the corresponding slide with what the instructor is saying.
docs.kf_usage_title: How to view Slide images in the interface:
docs.kf_usage_desc: On the video results page, the Keyframe Images tab displays all captured slides. Each slide image is attached with a timestamp (Example: 02:45). You just need to click on that slide image to seek the video player directly to the time that slide appears.
docs.rag_desc: The system not only provides one-way summaries but also allows you to chat directly to search for in-depth information in the lesson.
docs.rag_box1_desc: Lecture content is cut into small segments, converted into numerical sequences and saved to the Vector Database.
docs.rag_box2_desc: When submitting a question, the system retrieves text segments with the closest meaning in the lesson data store.
docs.rag_box3_desc: LLM receives the question with extracted context to generate the most accurate answer, avoiding hallucination.
docs.rag_usage_step1: In the analysis results page, click the 'RAG Q&A' button in the top right corner.
docs.rag_usage_step2: Enter questions related to the lecture (Example: 'How does the instructor explain Bayes' theorem at minute 10?').
docs.rag_usage_step3: The AI's answer will contain time link markers. Click on these markers to view the exact video segment.
